'''Special Tactics Group 32-Alpha''', also known as '''Ghost Striker Division''', was a unit in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Laverse]] was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the group, and the unit was assigned to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] at the request of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Lachris]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
